texts.zh:
一部分也要感谢[This.ContactCountry.GetName]显然非常渴望与我们建立联系，他们发送了大量的视听讯号并成为了翻译他们语言的关键，我们的翻译工蜂因而可以发表一个惊人的发现：这些外星人似乎是以个体而不是蜂巢思维的形式组织起来的。他们似乎可以极少的任何集体投入行动。最令人困惑的是，他们经常协作不良，并且似乎对其他工蜂正在做的事毫不知情。

我们尚未明白他们是如何在足够的智力水平下运作以发展到太空航行的地步。也许他们的背后仍有某种关联，但其中的子个体仅仅是比我们所了解的那样更加地独立自主？
texts.en:
Thanks in part to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] apparently being quite eager to establish communications with us - having sent a large audio and visual transmission that appears to offer the key to translating their language - our translation drones are able to report a startling discovery: these particular aliens seem to be organized as individuals, rather than a hive mind. They appear able to act with minimal input from any sort of collective. Most disturbingly, they are often poorly coordinated, and individual drones do not appear to instinctively know what other drones are doing.

We are not sure yet how they are able to operate at a sufficiently intelligent level to have advanced to the point of spaceflight. Perhaps there is a collective behind them, but the drones are simply far more independent than those we are used to?

texts.zh:
虽然我们努力地为我们的翻译工蜂获取了足够的信号来理解[This.ContactCountry.GetName]，但最新的汇报仍令人震惊：我们最初在[This.System.GetName]恒星系遭遇的外星人似乎是以个体而不是蜂巢思维的形式组织起来的。他们似乎可以极少的任何集体投入行动。最令人困惑的是，他们经常协作不良，并且似乎对其他工蜂正在做的事毫不知情。

我们尚未明白他们是如何在足够的智力水平下运作以发展到太空航行的地步。也许他们的背后仍有某种关联，但其中的子个体仅仅是比我们所了解的那样更加地独立自主？
texts.en:
Though we have struggled to gain access to enough signals for our translation drones to make much sense of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], the latest reports are startling: the aliens we first encountered in the [This.System.GetName] system seem to be organized as individuals, rather than as a hive mind. They appear able to act with minimal input from any sort of collective. Most disturbingly, they are often poorly coordinated, and individual drones do not appear to instinctively know what other drones are doing.

We are not sure yet how they are able to operate at a sufficiently intelligent level to have advanced to the point of spaceflight. Perhaps there is a collective behind them, but the drones are simply far more independent than those we are used to?

texts.zh:
由于[this.ContactCountry.GetName]方面表现出与我们建立通讯的明显意愿，我们已确认一项引人入胜的发现：这些生命体以个体的形式存在和运作，而非以格式塔的形式！

我们尚无法完全理解这种生活方式对这类外星生物如何奏效。或许它们与自己的行星母体之间存在着我们目前难以想象的某种联系？
texts.en:
Thanks to apparent eagerness from the [this.ContactCountry.GetName] to establish communications with us, we have confirmed an intriguing discovery: these lifeforms exist and operate as individuals, rather than as a gestalt!

We cannot yet fully comprehend how such a way of life works for aliens like these. Perhaps they feel a connection with their planetary bodies in ways we cannot yet conceive?

texts.zh:
尽管[this.ContactCountry.GetName]方面明显不愿与我们沟通，但通过我们的努力，我们确认了一项引人入胜的发现：这些隐居的生命形式以个体的形式存在和运作，而不是以集群意识！

我们尚无法完全理解这种生活方式对这类外星生物如何奏效。或许它们与自己的行星母体之间存在着我们目前难以想象的某种联系？
texts.en:
Despite clear reluctance from the [this.ContactCountry.GetName] to communicate with us, through our diligence we have confirmed an intriguing discovery: these reclusive lifeforms exist and operate as individuals, rather than as a gestalt!

We cannot yet fully comprehend how such a way of life works for aliens like these. Perhaps they feel a connection with their planetary bodies in ways we cannot yet conceive?

texts.zh:
我们的翻译子个体在解码从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]获取的信号的努力中取得了突破，并且现在有把握让我们与他们进行足够高层次的沟通以打开外交渠道。他们的调查也确认了我们的猜测：[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]（现在我们所知的正确叫法）完全缺失任何集体智能，并且是由可以独立思考的个体出于某种我们无法恰当理解的原因组织到一起，并自称为[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]。

由个体构成的高等级文明的发现引导我们思考了许多关于宇宙本质的假设。我们分配我们当中了不小的份额来调查他们到底如何发展并且克服根植于缺失如我们所知的集体智能导致缺陷的。
texts.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them on a sufficient level to open diplomatic channels with them. Their investigations have confirmed what we suspected: the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] (as we now know them to be properly called) completely lacks any sort of collective intelligence, and is instead made up of independent-thinking individuals who - for reasons we don't properly understand yet - choose to organize themselves into what they call a [This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName].

The discovery of a highly advanced civilization of individuals has led us to question many of our assumptions about the nature of the universe. We have devoted a not-insignificant part of ourselves to investigating how they developed and how they overcome the challenges inherent to the lack of a collective consciousness as we know it.

texts.zh:
我们的翻译子个体在解码从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]获取的信号的努力中取得了突破，并且现在有把握让我们与他们进行足够高层次的沟通以打开外交渠道。他们的调查也确认了我们的猜测：[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]（现在我们所知的正确叫法）完全缺失任何集体智能，并且是由可以独立思考的个体出于某种我们无法恰当理解的原因组织到一起，并自称为[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]。

虽然[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesName]的个体看起来非常美味，并且我们迫切地想要吞噬他们，但我们还是分配我们当中了不小的份额来调查他们到底如何发展并且克服根植于缺失如我们所知的集体智能导致缺陷的。
texts.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them on a sufficient level to open diplomatic channels with them. Their investigations have confirmed what we suspected: the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] (as we now know them to be properly called) completely lacks any sort of collective intelligence, and is instead made up of independent-thinking individuals who - for reasons we don't properly understand yet - choose to organize themselves into what they call a [This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName].

Although the individual [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesName] seems quite tasty, and we eagerly anticipate devouring them, we have devoted a not-insignificant part of ourselves to investigating how they developed and how they overcome the challenges inherent to the lack of a collective consciousness as we know it.

texts.zh:
我们在与[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的交流中取得了突破性进展。当我们理解到这些个体如何将其庞杂的社会结构归纳为少量抽象群体——这与我们自身的生物群落、种群和支系并无本质不同——便意识到如何与这些[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]达成更深入的共识。

尽管意识尺度上的巨大差异仍使外交充满挑战，但我们有望通过这些[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]所栖居的社会架构实现协调，他们称之为"[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]"。我们将持续关注此类社会建构带来的深远影响——尽管从我们行星文明的视角来看，它们既陌生又充满混沌。
texts.en:
We have made a triumphant breakthrough in our efforts to communicate with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Once we learned how these myriad individuals formed their society into a smaller number of abstract groups - not too dissimilar from our own biomes, packs, and clades - we realized how we might reach better accord with these [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

The vast differences in scale between our consciousnesses still makes diplomacy a challenging prospect, but we may reach accord with the organizations these [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] dwell under, in what they call a '[This.ContactCountry.GetGovernmentName]'. We shall continue to marvel at the ramifications of social constructs such as these - alien and chaotic though they may appear from our own planetary perspective.

summary.text:
# 个体化方案 / Suggestions of Individuality（蜂巢遇常规帝国）
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 首次接触阶段链 first-contact stage chain（首个事件 first_contact.380）

## 如何开始 How it starts

第二阶段抽取，权重 10000（几乎必选）：本方为蜂巢，对方为常规帝国，本方尚无 hive_encountered_default 标记，且与任何常规帝国都还未通讯（`common/first_contact/00_first_contact.txt:384–407`）。因此只在蜂巢帝国首次接触个体帝国时出现一次。/ Stage-2 weight 10000 (practically forced): owner is a hive mind, the contact a regular empire, the owner has no hive_encountered_default flag and no communications with any regular empire yet — a once-per-empire event.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. **个体化方案（380）**：译码无人机发现对方是“个体”而非集体；单选项进入收尾阶段（对方主动难度5 / 谨慎7），并设置 hive_encountered_default。/ The drones find they are individuals; one option enters the end stage.
2. **一个由个体构成的文明（385）**：突破性的译码；获得社会研究月加成。/ Translation breakthrough; society research bonus.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

线性，无分叉。/ Linear.
所有收尾选项都调用 finish_first_contact_effect（建立正式通讯，之后按帝国类型转入后续事件，如反向接触、教程、商队等），并调用 first_contact_inform_intel。 / Every ending option calls finish_first_contact_effect (opens regular communications, then routes to follow-ups such as reverse first contact, tutorial, caravaneer events) and first_contact_inform_intel.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

文本分荒野帝国与“吞噬”群落等变体；选项名随 civic（devouring swarm）变化。/ Text variants for wilderness empires and the devouring swarm civic.
